anxiety.definition:
n. (psychiatry) a relatively permanent state of worry and nervousness occurring in a variety of mental disorders, usually accompanied by compulsive behavior or attacks of panic
n. a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune
anxiety.translation:
n. 焦虑, 忧虑, 令人焦虑的事
[医] 焦虑

anxiety hysteria.translation: [医] 焦虑性癔病, 焦虑性歇斯底里

anxiety tension state.translation: [医] 神经肌肉紧张状态, 神经肌肉张力过强

anxiolytic.definition:
n a tranquilizer used to relieve anxiety and reduce tension and irritability
a anxiety relieving

anxiolytics.definition:
plural of anxiolytic
n a tranquilizer used to relieve anxiety and reduce tension and irritability
a anxiety relieving

anxious.definition:
s. eagerly desirous
s. causing or fraught with or showing anxiety
anxious.translation: a. 忧虑的, 发愁的, 渴望的

anxious seat.translation: 教堂"忧虑座", 焦虑不安

anxiously.translation: adv. 忧虑地, 不安地

anxiousness.definition: n. a feeling of mild anxiety about possible developments
